summary: Transitions are added in CSS. The HTML only needs elements that change state, like links and buttons people can hover or focus.
notes: Each meeting is a link, so it can be reached with the Tab key as well as the mouse.
Hover a meeting or the RSVP button in the preview to see the colors fade.
The links fill their list items in the CSS, so the whole row is clickable.
pitfall: Adding hover effects to a plain <div> or <li> that is not a link or button. Keyboard users can never trigger them.
